$comment: The host edge as data, read only by adapters/host.cjs.

No git rule is allowed (`git diff`, `git log`, `git show` take --output=<file>, so none of them is read-only); a person may add their own. `productMarker`: the file only this product's own tree holds.

`gateProbe`: the file nobody reads that doctor's probe names to ask the gates; a session's write tool may write it, and what a package's manifest declares (`sessionWrites`); the gate seals the rest of the product's store.

`hostUser`: where the AI host keeps a user's own settings (`settings`, and `local` beside it) and its own file, in `env`'s folder when set, else in the home; `leftovers` reads them for what an earlier AtlasBound wired there, and the port's seal asks the person before an AI's write to either settings file (a line there switches every hook off).

`notice`: the one hook row the team commits in the project's settings: in a clone this machine never set up it stops a session's first message once with `says` (a headless run never), and it says nothing where this machine is set up; `mark` names its once-per-session file in the temp folder and tells the row apart from a person's; `headless`: only a run whose `entry` is one of `interactive` (a person at the host's terminal or editor) is ever stopped; one whose `attended` is 0, or under `ci`, never.

`ignoreEntries`: the block setup writes into `.gitignore`; `mcp` joins it only while a wired package declares a server (its entry names this machine's node and install), else the repository's own file stays the repository's; a path a wired package's manifest names in `teamFiles` follows it as `!<path>`, left to git.

notice.says: atlasbound: this repository uses DecisionBook (the plans and decisions of the team come with git in .decisionbook/, and protected files need a READY plan before an AI edit), but it is not set up on this machine: this session edits with no plan gate and records no decision. Set it up once: npm install -g atlasbound, then atlasbound setup in this repository, then restart Claude Code. Send your message again to go on without it; this notice comes once per session.

rowGone: atlasbound: gates off: the node or program its hooks name is gone. Fix: atlasbound setup (or reinstall atlasbound), then restart the session.
